findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：客戶可能自行開發評分模型或其他產品（含以 AI 方案），可能減少或取消對 FICO 產品的採購；Scores 部門面對 VantageScore（三大徵信局合資），該分數在美國房貸市場獲更多監管認可。
findings.excerpt: This competition may include our customers developing their own scoring models or other products, including through the use of AI-based offerings, which could eliminate or reduce their purchases of our products and services. For example, our Scores segment faces competition from other credit score models, including VantageScore, which has experienced increased regulatory acceptance in the U.S. mortgage market.

findings.claim: 10-K 競爭清單把「in-house data science and systems developers」列為競爭來源之一。
findings.excerpt: We encounter competition from several sources, including: •in-house data science and systems developers; •developers and providers of large language models, machine learning, and AI systems;

findings.claim: FY2026 營收來自 Experian、TransUnion、Equifax 協議合計占總營收 60%（FY2025 51%、FY2024 45%）。
findings.excerpt: During fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024, revenues generated from our agreements with Experian, TransUnion and Equifax collectively accounted for 60%, 51% and 45% of our total revenues, respectively.

findings.claim: FHFA/Pulte 結束試行，指示 Fannie/Freddie 核准所有貸方使用 VantageScore。
findings.source: The Mortgage Reports: vantagescore fannie freddie all lenders
findings.excerpt: Mortgage News, roughly 50 lenders delivered loans under that pilot, and VantageScore 4.0 was used on more than 9% of mortgages Fannie and Freddie securitized between May 1 and August 31. On September 3, Pulte ended the pilot phase, posting: “So, EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY, I’m instructing Fannie and Freddie to approve ALL lenders to use VantageScore.”

customer_second_source.note: 三大徵信局（Experian/TransUnion/Equifax）合計占營收比（搜尋摘要稱 FY2026 為 60%）見 clues；VantageScore 為三局合資，同時是客戶與競爭對手。FHFA 9 月放行所有貸方使用 VantageScore 的報導未取得可逐字原文。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
